title: Ordinary representative coordinates for finite pullback and tensor
statement: Fix l,E,n and schemes in universe u. Use the existing ordinary identified-coefficient pullback, its exact derived functor and computation isomorphism, the fixed signed total tensor functor, the standard derived quotient, and the specified finite tensor-model and unit-normalized module realizations. Define tensor(P,Q) as the object of that same total tensor functor; define the finite representative and computation isomorphisms by composing the recorded realizations; define the ordinary module compositor by conjugating sfIntrinsicPullbackComp with the three finite realizations, and lift it termwise to complexes. The tensor comparison is the inverse of proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso. These are concrete composites of existing maps, with no new choices or mathematical assertions.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; ordinary tensor formula in sites-modules.tex, lemma-tensor-product-pullback (03EL); unit and adjunction composition in sites.tex (00YV).

proof.text: Specialize the existing functors at the finite coefficient sheaves and fix the existing standard derived category and abelian instances. Use a single uncurried signed total tensor functor for both the object and morphism operations. Compose the prescribed isomorphisms to define the representative, exact computation, and conjugated ordinary compositor. All definitions have complete Lean bodies and use no additional choice.

proof_origin.place: Explicit normalization and composition calculation in the proof of Tag 07A4, using the existing unit-normalized finite realizations.
